About me

UX first. Visual craft supports the experience.

I’m Zafar Sahel, a UX designer and researcher in the San Francisco Bay Area. I focus on products people use while stressed, overwhelmed, or navigating unclear systems.

My graphic-design background gives me strong visual judgment, but research, structure, interaction, and usability stay at the center of my work.

1Understand the real problem before committing to features.
2Connect research findings directly to product decisions.
3Test labels, hierarchy, and flows—not only polished screens.
